item.title: Goodwill Industries of Northwest Texas to host job fair on Tuesday
item.description: On Monday, Goodwill Industries of Northwest Texas announced an upcoming Goodwill Job Fair on Tuesday, at 5807 SW 45th Ave.

item.title: Texas Panhandle drought stagnant amid minor statewide improvement
item.description: The Texas Panhandle's drought conditions remained stagnant for the week of Jan. 27, according to the Texas Water Development Board, while statewide conditions saw their first slight improvement in eight weeks.

item.title: Free Whataburger: Feb. 4, National Honey Butter Chicken Biscuit Day
item.description: Whataburger invites Honey Butter Chicken Biscuit lovers for a free biscuit on Wednesday to celebrate National "Whataburger Honey Butter Chicken Biscuit Day."

item.title: Olympics hospitality area changes name amid ICE tensions in Milan: reports
item.description: U.S. figure skating, hockey and speedskating officials, in a joint statement, did not publicly disclose the reason for the change in a statement provided to media outlets.

item.title: Grandmother will serve life in prison in connection with 2024 deaths of 2 Kansas moms
item.description: A woman accused of killing two Kansas mothers in 2024 was sentenced Monday afternoon in an Oklahoma courtroom, after she pleaded no contest and was found guilty in October 2025 of two counts of first-degree murder, two counts of unlawful removal of a dead body and two counts of unlawful desecration of a human corpse.

item.title: Democrats celebrate upset win in Tarrant County, but Republicans expect payback in November
item.description: Taylor Rehmet, a veteran, machinist and union leader, pulled off an upset win for a Texas state senate seat in a reliably red district over the weekend. State and national Democratic leaders say the victory will give them momentum to do the same in other areas during the November midterms.

item.title: West Plains Cheer finishes 5th at UIL Spirit Championship, highest in program history
item.description: West Plains High School placed fifth at the UIL Spirit Championships held in Fort Worth last month. The top five finish is the highest the team has placed in program history.

item.title: A look at what to expect in the San Francisco Bay Area before the Big Game
item.description: The Big Game is this Sunday and KAMR Local 4 News, Fox 14 News, and Myhighplains.com will be checking in with reporters in the San Francisco Bay Area to get in-depth coverage of what to expect on and off the field before kick-off.

item.title: Crews working wreck on I-27 near Hollywood Monday
item.description: Multiple crews are on the scene of a rollover wreck on I-27 near Hollywood Road.
